blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A refurbished patrol vessel from the Taiwan Coast Guard formally entered Philippine service on Friday, renamed the BRP Sarangani (6177). The 61-meter-long ship was added to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) fleet at no cost to the government, according to a nongovernmental group which first acquired the vessel and donated it to […]...
